subject: Vendor onboarding: payor-agent delegation and alternative tax evidence
messages:
From: Anita Sharma <anita@lumenworks.co>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumenworks.co
Date: Sun, 10 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding – tax paperwork and alternate evidence

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. We started the W-8BEN-E but are running into two issues: our finance team cannot provide a notarized W-8BEN-E on company letterhead due to local policy, and our EIN confirmation letter is in process with our bank. We do have an executed payor-agent delegation (the party who will receive payments on our behalf) and a certified bank letter that proves account ownership.

Would Redwood accept a signed payor-agent delegation plus the bank letter as alternate evidence so procurement can continue with the PO? If not, what minimum combination of documents would satisfy the PO gate so we can avoid a hard hold?

Attached: payor-agent-delegation.pdf (signed), lumenworks-bank-letter.pdf (certified)

Appreciate a quick confirmation — PO timing is tight on our side.

Best,
Anita Sharma
Head of Finance Operations
LumenWorks
phone: +1-415-555-0142
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Sharma <anita@lumenworks.co>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 Mar 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding – tax paperwork and alternate evidence

Hi Anita — thanks for sending these over. Quick answers up front: yes, we can accept a payor-agent delegation in lieu of a notarized W-8BEN-E in certain cases, but Procurement needs the delegation to include specific attestations and an explicit signer authorization. Our Finance team also requires one of the following to validate tax identity: (a) EIN confirmation letter from the tax authority, (b) certified bank letter showing EIN or taxpayer reference, or (c) a government-issued registration extract.

Before we proceed I need you to:  
- Confirm the payor-agent PDF includes the delegated payor's name, relationship, scope of payment authority, and an authorized signatory block with printed name and title.
- Sign and return the attached Redwood payor-agent template (small changes help us process faster).
- If DocuSign is easier for you, we can accept a DocuSign envelope for the delegation and bank letter — please note DocuSign audit trail must be preserved.

If you can get the signed delegation + certified bank letter with an audit trail, procurement should be able to move the vendor to conditional PO release (PO in draft, payment hold until final tax evidence). Naomi, can you confirm conditional PO path and expected SLA if these docs arrive today?

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Attached: redwood-payor-agent-template.pdf
From: Anita Sharma <anita@lumenworks.co>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Kapoor <rajiv@lumenworks.co>, procurement@lumenworks.co
Date: Sun, 10 Mar 2029 12:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding – tax paperwork and alternate evidence

Thanks Soojin — updated and attached. We used your template and included the exact attestation language you requested. We executed via DocuSign to preserve the audit trail; envelope ID: 0a4b7-LLW. The bank letter includes our company registration number but not the EIN (bank policy) — it does tie the account to the registered entity name and shows account opening date.

Attached:
- payor-agent-delegation.pdf (DocuSign, executed)
- lumenworks-bank-letter.pdf (certified)

Question: is the bank letter + delegation sufficient to move to a conditional PO (draft issued, payment hold) while we finalize the EIN with the bank? We can also provide a company registration extract if that helps — we have the digital copy ready.

Appreciate quick confirmation as our projects are blocked by the PO timing.

Best,
Anita

Naomi: finance confirms we can proceed to conditional PO release with the submitted documents plus a digital company registration extract (official government PDF) — final payment will remain on hold until EIN confirmation or IRS-equivalent is provided. Anita, please upload the registration extract to the DocuSign envelope or reply with the PDF link. Once we have that, Procurement will issue the PO in draft and share the PO number for your side to reference the order.

DocuSign link (for Redwood records and e-sign audit): https://na.docs.redwood.com/docusign/ABC123-payor-agent
HubSpot ticket: HS-0029876
